bio.text: According to a July 2021 Brooklyn Magazine profile, Zellnor Myrie was born in Brooklyn to Costa Rica-born immigrant parents and was raised in Prospect Lefferts Gardens.
The profile says he earned a master's degree in urban studies from Fordham and a law degree from Cornell, then worked at the law firm Davis Polk & Wardwell.
It reports that he left the firm to run for the state Senate in 2018, defeating Jesse Hamilton in the race for the 20th District, which covers parts of Brooklyn.
